text: Imagine you are standing on a quiet street in New York, a hot dog cart steaming next to you.
What if the earthquakes kept getting stronger?
Normally the ground barely trembles beneath your feet.
At magnitude three, only the pigeons notice.
At magnitude five, New York matches its eighteen eighty four record and windows rattle.
Each whole step releases thirty two times more energy.
At seven, the street is no longer flat and cars stop driving.
Nine point five is the strongest ever recorded, in Chile in nineteen sixty.
At ten, no known fault is long enough and the ground moves like water.
At twelve, the street splits wide open.
At fifteen, the ground throws you into space.
Past eighteen, Earth cannot hold itself together anymore.
At fifty, it releases more energy than the entire universe has.
The scale itself has no upper limit.
So where would it finally stop?
